visualCharacteristics.purpose: Continuously auto-scrolling row of partner logos with no controls
description: Continuous auto-scrolling row of partner logos, no controls

contentPattern.structure: one cell per row: partner logo image with alt text = partner name (optionally linked). The list is duplicated by the block for a seamless loop; pauses on hover/focus and stops for reduced motion
notes: Auto-scrolling, infinitely looping logo marquee is an interactive slider of repeating image-only items.

usage: Use for partner, client or certification logo strips.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any looping logo strip; author each logo once, the block handles duplication.
